verdict: Spend is live, but zero leads were captured — conversion path needs fixing.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $106.10 was spent on Meta advertising, generating 211 clicks and 3,026 website sessions — but zero leads were recorded across every channel. The clicks are arriving; the problem is that the conversion path (landing pages and form tracking) was not fully built and verified before spend went live, so no inquiry is being captured when a visitor arrives. We are completing the landing pages, tracking setup, and lead-form configuration now so that clicks translate into recorded leads. Until those pieces are confirmed live and tested, ad spend is being kept minimal to avoid further untracked cost.

watch_item.issue: The conversion path — landing pages, lead forms, and tracking — was not live before ads launched, so zero leads have been recorded this period.
watch_item.fix: Landing pages and conversion tracking are being completed and verified this week; spend will scale only after a confirmed end-to-end test shows leads are being captured correctly.
